pages.text: Run extra processors on living targets already on fire, then ignite selected entities. Newly ignited targets do not immediately receive those extras.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Ignition costs 20*t per target. Extra effects on already burning targets keep their own costs.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 plus attached effects, independent of burn duration or target count.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)Already burning targets$(br)Effect / Add up to 64 nodes
